failure_modes.name: Manure ingress
failure_modes.symptoms: Corrosion at seams; clogged vents; sensor fouling; motor housing contamination; odor/shorting
failure_modes.mitigation: Washdown-rated enclosures; scheduled high-pressure cleaning; drainage design; conformal-coated electronics

failure_modes.name: Bumper sensor
failure_modes.symptoms: False obstacle triggers; stuck bumper; missed collision detection; erratic stop behavior
failure_modes.mitigation: Switch contact cleaning; bumper travel re-calibration; redundant proximity sensing; self-test on startup

failure_modes.name: Charging contact corrosion
failure_modes.symptoms: Intermittent charge; high contact resistance; arcing; failure to reach full charge; docking retries
failure_modes.mitigation: Gold-plated/contamination-resistant contacts; contact wipe on dock; corrosion inhibitor; contact resistance monitor

failure_modes.name: Wheel slip
failure_modes.component: Traction wheel / drivetrain on barn floor
failure_modes.symptoms: Loss of traction on wet/slick floor; odometry error; missed waypoints; spinning wheels
failure_modes.mitigation: Aggressive tread pattern; reduced speed on known-wet zones; IMU/encoder slip detection; floor-grip-aware planner
